payload.detail: CORRECTED 2026-09-27 (Codex review on PR 3128; the first count missed multi-line expect calls and On Call lines had drifted): 11 assertions use expect(await locator.count()), which never retries, on main 7f8312f2c: tests/answer-progress-ui-smoke.spec.ts:631, tests/ui-accessibility.spec.ts:343, tests/ui-dictionary.spec.ts:377, tests/ui-formulation-result-cards.spec.ts:52, tests/ui-on-call-boards.spec.ts:535, 544, 662 and 743, tests/ui-smoke.spec.ts:2258, 3211 and 3212.
